advisor_identified: Historian of modern United States politics and the presidency, professor of history at McGill University since 1990.

doctorate.title: See How They Run: The Changing Role of Presidential Candidates, 1840-1912

evidence.says: McGill identifies Gil Troy as a history professor who joined its history faculty in 1990 and states that his doctoral degree was from Harvard University.
The November 2005 profile identifies Troy as a McGill history professor researching modern United States political history and lists his education as a Harvard University PhD, 1988.

The Journal of American History, volume 76, issue 3 (December 1989), Recent Scholarship, p. 1058, lists Gilad E. Troy with the dissertation title See How They Run: The Changing Role of Presidential Candidates, 1840-1912, Harvard University, 1988; dissertation order number DA8901661.

notes: Institution, year, and dissertation title match the linked AHA record. The contemporary dissertation bibliography uses the fuller name Gilad E. Troy. Title evidence was read in the publisher-hosted issue back matter; the stable publisher issue page is linked.
